editor.title: Editar grupo
editor.copy: Agrega un sitio web por linea. Se aceptan dominios y URL completas.
editor.typeSummarySite: Tipo: grupo de bloqueo de sitios web predeterminado.
editor.typeSummaryYouTube: Tipo: grupo de bloqueo de YouTube. Varios grupos de YouTube pueden acumularse, incluidas las listas blancas de creadores.
editor.typeSummaryTikTok: Type: TikTok block group. Filter by content type and author when available.
editor.typeSummaryFacebook: Type: Facebook block group. Filter by content type and author when available.
editor.typeSummaryInstagram: Type: Instagram block group. Filter by content type and author when available.
editor.typeSummaryTwitch: Type: Twitch block group. Filter by content type and author when available.
editor.typeSummaryReddit: Tipo: grupo de bloqueo de Reddit. Deja vacia la lista de subreddits para aplicar a todo Reddit, o limita el grupo a comunidades concretas.
editor.typeSummaryDiscord: Type: Discord block group. Filter by server when available.
editor.typeSummaryCustom: Tipo: grupo de reglas personalizadas. Tu funcion de JavaScript decide que dominios deben bloquearse.
platform.copy: Choose whether this group applies to all {platform}, only {shortLabel}, only {longLabel}, only {postLabel}, certain authors, or a combination.
platform.authorModeExclude: Apply to all except certain authors
platform.help.youtube: Author filtering applies on {platform}. The short-vs-long selector also works on supported video sites when their page type can be identified.
platform.help.generic: Author filtering applies when author identifiers can be detected. Content types map to {shortLabel}, {longLabel}, and {postLabel} when those page forms are detectable.
reddit.title: Filtros de Reddit
reddit.copy: Aplica este grupo a todo Reddit, solo a ciertos subreddits o a todos los subreddits excepto ciertos.
reddit.modeAll: Aplicar a todas las paginas de Reddit
reddit.modeExclude: Aplicar a todos excepto ciertos subreddits
reddit.help: Usa un subreddit por linea. Se aceptan tanto nombres simples como `productivity` como rutas como `r/productivity`.
discord.title: Discord Filters
discord.copy: Apply this group to all of Discord, only certain servers, or all servers except certain ones.
discord.modeExclude: Apply to all except certain targets
discord.help: Use one Discord server ID per line. Plain IDs and links containing `/channels/<serverId>/...` are accepted.
discord.channelsHelp: Use one Discord channel ID per line. Plain IDs and links containing `/channels/<serverId>/<channelId>` are accepted.
status.allowlistWarning: El modo lista permitida suele dejar el feed vacio o lleno de anuncios. La plataforma puede seguir recomendando otro contenido.
status.redditAllowlistWarning: El modo lista permitida oculta todos los subreddits que no incluiste. El feed de Reddit puede seguir mostrando anuncios o comunidades fuera de la lista.
status.discordAllowlistWarning: Allow-list mode blocks every server you did not list. Direct messages and @me pages are not server-specific and may stay accessible.
status.discordChannelAllowlistWarning: Allow-list mode blocks every channel you did not list. You may still see channels that are not targetable from the current URL.
custom.title: Blocking Rules
custom.copy: Introduce una funcion de JavaScript que pueda agregar o devolver los dominios que deben bloquearse ahora mismo.
custom.help: La funcion recibe month, dayOfMonth, dayName, hour, minute, blockedDomains y un objeto helpers. helpers.timerHelper administra temporizadores de cuenta regresiva ligados a un dominio, helpers.persistenceHelper guarda datos entre ejecuciones, y helpers.domainHelper / helpers.logHelper ofrecen utilidades extra. Devuelve una lista actualizada de dominios, o modifica blockedDomains y no devuelvas nada.
custom.editorCopy: Introduce una funcion de JavaScript que devuelva los dominios a bloquear. El trabajador en segundo plano la vuelve a ejecutar aproximadamente cada segundo; si tarda demasiado, reducira la frecuencia. Usa helpers.timerHelper para cuentas regresivas y helpers.persistenceHelper para recordar estado.
custom.defaultRule: (month, dayOfMonth, dayName, hour, minute, url, helpers) => false
schedule.title: Horario
schedule.copy: Limita este grupo a ciertos dias o franjas horarias.
schedule.help: Dejalo en blanco para aplicar todo el dia. Usa un rango por linea en formato HHMM-HHMM.

sites.label: Sitios bloqueados
hint.copy: Enabled groups use the browser's native extension-blocked behavior, similar to ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT.
unfreeze.message.1: Are you sure you want to give up your self-discipline?
unfreeze.message.2: One deep breath. Are you really choosing distraction right now?
unfreeze.message.3: Future you is watching. Still want to weaken this rule?
unfreeze.message.4: That urge will pass. Are you certain you want to open this door?
unfreeze.message.5: Discipline is expensive to build and cheap to lose. Continue?
unfreeze.message.6: You made this guardrail for a reason. Do you want to lower it?
unfreeze.message.7: This is your focused self asking for one more pause. Continue?
unfreeze.message.8: Temptation sounds reasonable for a minute. Are you still sure?
unfreeze.message.9: If you confirm, your willpower has to work harder later. Continue?
unfreeze.message.10: This click is not neutral. Do you still want to give in?
unfreeze.message.11: Imagine how you will feel in ten minutes. Still unfreeze?
unfreeze.message.12: You are very close to talking yourself out of discipline. Continue?
unfreeze.message.13: Your boundary is holding. Do you want to be the one who breaks it?
unfreeze.message.14: This is a tiny rebellion against your own goals. Continue?
unfreeze.message.15: You built a system because motivation is unreliable. Still proceed?
unfreeze.message.16: The shortcut is glowing. Are you certain it is worth it?
unfreeze.message.17: Pause again. Do you want comfort now more than progress later?
unfreeze.message.18: This is the part where discipline usually wins. Are you opting out?
unfreeze.message.19: Almost there. Last chance to keep your promise to yourself.
unfreeze.message.20: Final check: are you absolutely sure you want to give up your self-discipline?
